subject: general
question: In January 2022, India signed a USD 374.96-million deal with the _______, its single biggest defence export order.
solution:
the correct answer is __**Philippines**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In January 2022, India signed a USD 374.96-million deal with the Philippines, its single biggest defence export order.
 
• The deal was for the supply of three batteries of the shore-based anti-ship variant of the** BrahMos supersonic cruise missile**.
